results.title: Superconducting Qubit Chain Drives Dephasing to Zero Without Error Correction
results.description: Superconducting qubit noise protection takes a new form: a seven-member international team demonstrates theoretically that a qubit chain with alternating XX-YY ultrastrong coupling drives dephasing to exactly zero and halves relaxation, eliminating phase noise at the hardware level without quantum error correction overhead.

results.title: LG Sinha Expresses Grief Over Fatal Road Accident in Rajouri
results.description: Rajouri, August 16: Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha has expressed deep anguish over the loss of lives in an unfortunate road accident in Kotranka area of Rajouri district. In a post on X, the Lieutenant Governor said he was “deeply pained” by the loss of lives in the accident and conveyed his heartfelt condolences to the bereaved families. Sinha also prayed for the early recovery of those injured in the mishap. He said he had directed the district administration to ensure the best possible treatment for the injured and provide all necessary assistance. The accident has caused grief in the Kotranka area, with authorities responding to the situation and extending support to the affected families and injured persons.
